description:
TOM MCDONALD & ASSOCIATES - EXPERIENCED, PROFESSIONAL, TRUSTED - are pleased to offer to the market this Wonderful, Turn Key, Concrete Built 3 Bed Bungalow with Large & Sunny, South Facing Rear Garden. 

Situated in a Mature Development with Community Centre in a Rural Village, with Shop, Pub, Church & School yet just a short drive to Rathangan Town & M7 Motorway. 

Overlooking a Green Area to the front, this Ideal Family Home has Excellent Development Potential to the Rear. Renovated approximately 10 years ago to include insulation, rewiring, double glazed windows and doors, the property was also recently Painted throughout. 

Accommodation is comprised of Entrance Hall, Open Plan Living/Kitchen/Dining Area, 3 Bedrooms and a Shower Room. 

There is a Quality Fitted Kitchen with Beautiful Splashback that comes with Oven, Hob, Microwave, Fridge Freezer & Washing Machine. A feature solid fuel stove with back boiler in the Living Area creates a Cosy Atmosphere.

All Bedrooms have Laminate Timber Floors & are Double Size Rooms with one Bedroom featuring a Fireplace with Brick Surround. 

The Shower Room is Fully Tiled and has an Electric Shower. 

In the Rear Garden is a Small Concrete Shed, Ideal for Storage. Vehicular Access to the Rear. 

This Super Property is a Must View. Let’s make it yours! 

Mains Sewerage & Electricity, Group Scheme Water. Fibre Broadband Available. 

Built c. 1960. BER No. 106281470.
